# Bosnia WC2026 Web3 Sticker Album

## Overview
Bosnia WC2026 Web3 Sticker Album is a decentralized application (dApp) built on the Solana blockchain. It allows users to collect, trade, and view digital stickers of the Bosnian national football team for the 2026 World Cup.

## Features
- Collect digital stickers of Bosnian players as NFTs on the Solana blockchain.
- Connect Solana wallets like Phantom or Solflare to view and manage collections.
- Earn rewards and claim exclusive items for completing the album.

## Technologies
- Frontend: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS
- Blockchain: Solana, Metaplex
- Deployment: Vercel

## URLs
- **Main App**: https://bosnia-collection.vercel.app
